property_summary: For any successful 10-ether fallback call with a fresh (strictly increasing) timestamp, C pays out its whole balance exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 and keeps its balance otherwise; the mutant inverts this payout condition and so drains (or keeps) funds on the wrong block classes.
change_summary: Invert the payout condition so funds are sent on every block number not divisible by 15 instead of divisible by 15.
